description:
Log in to Canvas as admin (canvas@example.edu / canvas-docker). Navigate to the BIO101 course and create a new Quiz named 'BIO101 Final Examination'. Configure the following settings:
- Quiz Type: Graded Quiz
- Time Limit: 90 minutes
- Allowed Attempts: 1
- Access Code: 'BIO101FINAL'
- Shuffle Answers: Yes
- Show One Question at a Time: Yes
- Description: Must include the phrases 'comprehensive final' and 'closed-book'
- Due Date: 21 days from today
- Available From: 20 days from today
- Available Until: 22 days from today

Finally, ensure the quiz is Published.
